concepts.core_mechanic: Holding Space spends marker ink to paint a red boost road directly behind your car while you steer. Release Space while still on your fresh ink to launch forward, so the fastest line is a road you just drew — but the blue car can steal a ride on it too.
concepts.juice: Red and blue paper-skid trails, yellow star sparkles on gate boosts, ink splats when marker paint lands, cone bounce and spin with a tiny screen shake on car-to-car bumps, speed lines at boost speed, squash-and-stretch cars when they hit the track edge, and big floating text that pops in for LAP 2! and FINAL LAP!.
concepts.lose: The blue car finishes three laps first and the on-screen text says: "BLUE WINS! TRY AGAIN!"
concepts.pitch: Race the red No. 5 car around a hand-drawn paper track and beat the blue No. 8 to the trophy in three laps.

roles.role: The player's big red No. 5 race car, shown top-down and rotating as it steers around the paper track.
The blue No. 8 rival car, racing the same three laps on its own fast line.
The gold trophy prize displayed huge at track center and awarded to the winner after three laps.
Short orange track cones that spin away and slow either car when clipped.
The taller orange pylon marking a narrow boost gate on each lap.
The marker pickup that refills the player's ink meter for painting boost roads.
The start/finish flag at the lap line, waving each time a car completes a lap.

concepts.title: Paper Grand Prix
concepts.win: Finish three laps before the blue car and the on-screen text says: "YOU WIN THE TROPHY!"

concepts.controls: Left / Right or A / D: Drive the red car | Space: Launch the flag / hold to stretch the ink guard | Enter: Start / Restart
concepts.core_mechanic: The ball is a tumbling checkered flag, and the red car is the paddle. Holding Space paints a short-lived marker-ink wall behind the car that can save a falling flag once — but every save makes the flag fall faster and ricochet at a wilder angle.
concepts.juice: Paper confetti bursts when cones break, double sparkles and a bigger shake for two-hit pylons, a waving ribbon trail behind the flag ball, ink splatter and stretch when the guard wall saves a life, squash on every car bounce, floating combo text like COMBO x4!, and the trophy's star pulsing faster as bricks clear.
concepts.lose: Lose all three flags before reaching the trophy and the text says: "OUT OF FLAGS! BLUE TAKES THE TROPHY!"
concepts.pitch: Bounce a tumbling checkered flag off the red No. 5 car to smash through a wall of cones and pylons and knock the trophy loose before the blue No. 8 steals it.

roles.role: The player's red No. 5 car, driving left and right along the bottom as the paddle.
The blue No. 8 rival car, patrolling upside-down at the top as a moving blocker that knocks the flag back down.
The gold trophy prize sitting behind the brick wall; hit it three times to win it.
One-hit orange bricks forming the lower rows of the wall.
Taller two-hit orange bricks in the upper rows that crack after the first hit.
The marker power-up that drops from broken bricks and refills the ink guard meter.
The tumbling checkered flag used as the bouncing ball, plus the three spare flags shown as lives.

concepts.title: Trophy Breakout Rally
concepts.win: Clear the wall, hit the exposed trophy three times, and the text says: "TROPHY DOWN! YOU WIN!"

concepts.controls: Arrows / WASD: Move one tile (push cones and pylons) | Space: Wait one turn | Enter: Start / Restart
concepts.core_mechanic: This is a turn-based race on a paper grid: every time the red car moves one tile, the blue car also rolls one tile closer to the trophy. Push a light cone to block a lane, or shove a heavy pylon so it slides until it hits something — building the blue car's traffic jam is how you win.
concepts.juice: Chunky tile-by-tile hops with squash and stretch, orange dust puffs when cones land, a sliding trail and screen shake when a pylon slams to a stop, red ink splashes on painted tiles, the flag snapping and sparkling on each checkpoint, blue-car engine puffs on every one of its turns, and a star burst with floating BLOCKED! text when the rival bumps into your trap.
concepts.lose: The blue car reaches the trophy first, or the red car runs out of moves, and the text says: "BLUE GOT THE TROPHY! TRY AGAIN!"
concepts.pitch: Outsmart the blue No. 8 in a turn-based paper-grid race by pushing cones and sliding pylons into its path on your way to the trophy.

roles.role: The player's red No. 5 car, moving one grid tile at a time and pushing obstacles.
The blue No. 8 rival car that automatically rolls one tile toward the trophy after every player move.
The gold trophy goal tile at the far end of the grid.
Light pushable blockers that move exactly one tile when bumped.
Heavy pushable blockers that slide in a straight line until they hit a wall, car, or obstacle.
A marker tile that paints the square red when driven over; the blue car will not cross fresh red ink.
The checkpoint flag tile the red car must touch to unlock the trophy on each board.

concepts.title: Gridlock Trophy Dash
concepts.win: Touch the flag, then reach the trophy before the blue car in all three boards, and the text says: "THREE BOARDS CLEAR! TROPHY WON!"
